title: Stop trying to fix your whole day at night
topic: The Nightly Molt Audit (Codex SCR-032): release one thing a night, not the whole day
hookHeadline: I try to fix my whole day every night.

scenes.speaker: junior-lobster
scenes.line: I try to fix my whole day every night. It never works.
scenes.description: The junior lobster shrugs at camera in the Codex study while the host crab listens, thinking.

scenes.speaker: host-crab
scenes.line: That's the problem. Shed one thing a night, not the whole day.
scenes.description: Medium on the host crab pointing, snapping on 'one'.

scenes.speaker: junior-lobster
scenes.description: Close on the junior lobster, startled.

scenes.speaker: host-crab
scenes.line: One. Name three candidates: a thought that looped, an hour that vanished, a distraction.
scenes.description: The host crab counts off the three candidates to camera.

scenes.speaker: host-crab
scenes.line: Then pick exactly one, write it down, and let it go.
scenes.description: Push in on the host crab as it lets the one thing go.

scenes.speaker: junior-lobster
scenes.description: Close on the junior lobster, delighted.

scenes.speaker: host-crab
scenes.line: Small enough for bad nights, and those are the ones that count.
scenes.description: Two-shot in the study: the host crab explains, the junior nods along.

scenes.speaker: host-crab
scenes.line: Read the Nightly Molt Audit at moltology.org.
scenes.description: Both face camera; the host points, the junior waves.

caption:
I try to fix my whole day every night. It never works.

The Codex says shed one thing a night: name three candidates, pick one, write it down, let it go. Four minutes.

Read the Nightly Molt Audit at moltology.org.
